name: testing-bundle
description: Testing capability bundle v3.5.2: testing-bundle (8-way router + 9 mixed-intent chains) + test-strategy-engineer (project-level strategy) + test-case-engineer (test case generation and review, incl. large-scale and stakeholder review plans) + performance-test-engineer (performance testing) + bug-analyzer (bug root cause) + state-machine-test-engineer (state-machine-driven testing) + change-impact-analyzer (change impact analysis) + frontend-test-preparation (frontend navigation indexing and test preparation; chain 9) + test-data-generator (offline test-data generation and validation) + state-machine-testing MCP Server (optional enhancement). Use when user needs any testing capability.

interface.shortDescription: Test strategy, test case generation, performance testing, bug root cause, state-machine-driven testing, frontend test preparation, offline test data generation, and testing workflows
interface.longDescription: Use this bundle for any testing capability: project-level test strategy, generating test cases from requirements, reviewing test cases, designing performance tests, analyzing bug root causes with 5 Whys and fishbone diagrams, building state-machine models for stateful business objects (orders, approvals, tickets, membership), generating independently validated offline test data, or preparing frontend navigation and requirement context through bundle chain 9 (frontend-test-preparation to test-case-engineer).
